tagline.en: Plain-text recipes in the CookLang format — versionable in git, with no database and no forms
tagline.pt: Receitas em texto puro no formato CookLang — versionáveis em git, sem banco e sem formulário

aisle.conf.example.note: Both live in config/ INSIDE the recipes folder — cookcli looks there first and then in ~/.config/cook/. Since the volume is the /recipes directory, the destination cannot be derived from the unit.

bolo-de-cenoura.cook.example.note: Reference recipes: installing gives you something to copy as a model, and the one in molhos/ exists to demonstrate references between recipes.
